name: Business Director Residence Permit

requirements.blocker_text: Requires a business license from the Department of Economic Affairs.
Requires a director's license from the Department of Economic Affairs, obtained before applying for the residence permit.

outcome.duration_length: temporary, tied to the business/director license

sources.title: Ministry of Justice, Government of Sint Maarten -- Immigration and Border Protection Services: Business Director residence pathway, requiring director's and business licenses from the Department of Economic Affairs before the residence permit application

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Sint Maarten's initial build. No minimum capital, employee count, or fee figure was found for this route -- distinct from the real-estate/investment PR route (sx_real_estate_investment_residence.json), this is a business-ownership/directorship residence pathway rather than a passive-investment one, and the two are not interchangeable per the sources reviewed. work_rights is 'restricted' to the applicant's own business (not general employment), consistent with how equivalent business-director/entrepreneur routes are modelled elsewhere in this dataset. leads_to_pr/pr_after_months (60 months) reflects Sint Maarten's general 5-year path to permanent residency applicable across residence-permit categories.
